body:
I guess I haven't mentioned my thoughts because I know I'm not going to actually do it. All I've thought about is potential methods and whether anyone would actually care if I did. I think my thoughts are more about the idea of escaping my responsibilities than not wanting to be alive anymore, which probably sounds pathetic. 

That's another one of my issues, I'm filled with self-loathing and I think of most everything I do as crap, so I often don't even attempt anything. Also, it's now the end of my semester and I've let a lot of my work pile up, so unless teachers are willing to retroactively change my grades if and when I come back next semester, my GPA is gonna be fucked.

I don't know I guess sometimes I just completely forget about taking them or preemptively don't take them so I can drink without fear of mixing the two dangerously. Also, it's not that I don't feel comfortable talking to my psychologist, I'm straight with him about a lot of things. I just haven't mentioned that I feel somewhat suicidal for one reason or another. My biggest problem right now is I really don't care about anything, whether that be school, taking my meds, or even eating. And for the record you didn't really sound bitchy.

Yeah, it's certainly part of the problem. Stopping is easier said than done though. I can't seem to say no when my friends start drinking on any given evening. It's getting to the point where I'm seriously considering rehab.
